description.zh: 经典数字合成游戏。滑动方块让相同数字相撞合并，一路向 2048 进发。支持撤销一步、最高分存档，还能继续挑战更大的方块。
description.en: The classic number-merging game. Slide tiles, merge equal numbers and climb toward 2048. Undo a move, keep your best score, and keep going for tiles beyond 2048.

controls.zh: 方向键 / WASD / 触屏滑动移动方块，U 或按钮撤销一步，Esc / P 暂停
controls.en: Arrow keys / WASD / swipe to move tiles, U or the button to undo, Esc / P to pause
